title: Desk Ruling on the Forfeit Share Taken on a Closed Commission
content:
# Desk Ruling on the Forfeit Share Taken on a Closed Commission

**Ruling.** On a commission under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions, the forfeit share taken turns on whether a stage of production stands recorded on the commission, on whether the piece has been recorded as finished, and on when the closure is confirmed.

1. Where a stage of production stands recorded on the commission and the piece has not been recorded as finished, the share is the programme's heavier forfeit share.
2. Where no stage of production stands recorded and the closure is confirmed after the programme's cancellation window has run in calendar days from the date the design was approved, the share is the studio's late closure share, which is 35 per cent.
3. Otherwise the share is the programme's lighter forfeit share.

## The readings the ruling rests on

| Reading | Taken from |
|---|---|
| Does a stage of production stand recorded? | The commission's own production stage entries; one stands recorded where at least one such entry has been booked |
| Has the piece been recorded as finished? | The date production finished, as it stands on the commission; the piece has been recorded as finished where that date stands, and has not where it is empty |
| Has the cancellation window run? | The days from the date the design was approved, as recorded on the commission, to the day the closure is confirmed, set against the programme's cancellation window in calendar days; the window has run once those days come to more than the window |

## The programme shares and windows

| Programme | Heavier forfeit share | Lighter forfeit share | Cancellation window (calendar days from design approval) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Design Studio Semi-Custom Setting | 50 per cent | 10 per cent | 3 |
| Design Studio Custom Setting | 60 per cent | 15 per cent | 5 |
| Belrose Bespoke Design | 75 per cent | 20 per cent | 7 |
| Belrose Bespoke Signature Commission | 85 per cent | 25 per cent | 10 |
| Belrose Heritage Redesign Commission | 75 per cent | 20 per cent | 7 |
| Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission | 100 per cent | 35 per cent | 14 |

## Readings (hypothetical)

- A Belrose Bespoke Signature Commission with a casting stage recorded and no date of production finishing: the share is 85 per cent.
- The same commission with no production stage recorded, the design approved 11 calendar days earlier and a window of 10 days: the window has run, and the share is 35 per cent.
- The same commission with no production stage recorded and the design approved 10 calendar days earlier: the window has not run, and the share is 25 per cent.
- A Design Studio Semi-Custom Setting commission with a stone setting stage recorded and the date production finished standing on it: neither of the first two applies, and the share is 10 per cent.
